title: Bonafide Certificate
content: A Bonafide Certificate confirms a student is currently enrolled. Required: student ID and purpose (e.g. bank loan, visa, scholarship). Processing time is 2 working days. No fee is charged.

title: Transfer Certificate
content: A Transfer Certificate is issued only after all dues (library, hostel, lab) are cleared. Requires a no-dues form signed by all departments. Processing time is 5 working days. Fee: 200 INR.

title: Character Certificate
content: Character Certificates require no disciplinary record in the current academic year. Issued by the Dean of Student Affairs. Processing time is 3 working days.

title: General certificate request rules
content: All certificate requests must include full name, student ID, certificate type, and purpose. Incomplete requests will be returned for clarification before processing begins.
